Our firm

A firm where every title is earned

Trueworth gives clear, senior-led legal advice to businesses, families and individuals.

Who we are

We act for people who want a lawyer who understands what is at stake and says what they think.

Trueworth advises on corporate and commercial matters, disputes, finance, property, employment, intellectual property and private client work.

We are deliberately built differently. The people who founded the firm hold themselves to the same rules as everyone who joins it, and those rules are written down.

Our principles

Five principles behind everything we do

  1. 01

    Titles are earned

    No one is given seniority they have not shown, the founders included.

  2. 02

    The client hears the truth plainly

    Clear advice and a clear recommendation, in words a client can act on.

  3. 03

    Two people check what matters

    Advice, deadlines and money never rest on one person alone.

  4. 04

    The firm comes before any one of us

    Decisions, credit and the name belong to Trueworth.

  5. 05

    We grow our people

    Every lawyer should end each year better than they started it.

Titles are earned

Even our founders start as Senior Associates

At Trueworth, no one is given seniority they have not shown. The founders hold the title Senior Associate, and become Partners only after five years of committed practice.

That step is measured against published criteria and confirmed by an independent senior lawyer from outside the firm. Lawyers who join from other firms also start below Partner, whatever their previous title.

For clients, it means the title on our letters is one that has been earned.

  1. Trainee
  2. Associate
  3. Senior AssociateFounders start here
  4. PartnerAfter five years and independent review

Our commitments

What you can expect from us

  1. One named lawyer

    Every matter has one lawyer responsible for it, and you know who that is from the first letter.

  2. Replies within one working day

    Every message gets a reply within one working day. If the full answer takes longer, we tell you when it will come.

  3. A clear recommendation

    Our advice ends with what we recommend and why, not only a list of options.

  4. Fees in writing first

    Before work starts you receive a written estimate and scope. If the work will cost more, we tell you before we go over it.

  5. Plain English

    We write for the person making the decision, not for other lawyers.
